traceability.notes:
All acceptance criteria and requirements from docs/stories/022.0-DEV-JSDOC-COEXISTENCE.story.md are fully implemented.
Implementation: The valid-annotation-format rule and its helpers now explicitly support coexistence with other JSDoc tags. normalizeCommentLine preserves line boundaries and isolates traceability tags; isNonTraceabilityJSDocTagLine generically detects any non-traceability @tag line as a boundary; processCommentLine terminates pending @story/@req state at those boundaries and only continues multi-line values on non-@tag lines. This directly implements REQ-JSDOC-TAG-COEXISTENCE, REQ-ANNOTATION-TERMINATION, REQ-JSDOC-BOUNDARY-DETECTION, REQ-CONTINUATION-LOGIC, REQ-NO-FALSE-POSITIVES, and REQ-PRESERVE-MULTILINE.
Testing: tests/rules/valid-annotation-format.test.ts contains targeted, traceability-linked tests covering traceability before, after, and interleaved with @param/@returns, multi-line annotation preservation, and a regression scenario that previously produced a concatenated requirement ID (REQ-OPTIMIZATION@param{object}data). All of these tests pass in the latest Jest run (npm test -- --verbose), along with a large suite of preexisting tests, confirming both the new behavior and backward compatibility.
Documentation: docs/rules/valid-annotation-format.md has a dedicated "JSDoc coexistence" section explaining the behavior and giving a concrete example that matches the story’s intent.
Given the aligned implementation, passing tests, and updated documentation, Story 022.0-DEV-JSDOC-COEXISTENCE is fully satisfied.
